summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by First Interstate BancSystem, Inc. reporting quarterly earnings results under Item 2.02, furnishing a press release and investor presentation under Item 7.01, and announcing a regular quarterly dividend of $0.47 per share under Item 8.01. No special situation event—such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or unusual management change—is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report on operating results and ordinary capital allocation. There are no deal terms or structural mechanics to analyze; the only notable action is a normal dividend declaration.
